metadata.title: Clicked like a confused chicken and somehow pulled a 2-for-1 clutch?! Valorant aim is wild
metadata.description:
Me: panicking like I lost my mouse
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-confusion
How did that even land twice? No clue but I’ll take it
If your aim’s a lovable disaster, welcome aboard

Tap if your aim ever surprises even you mid-panic!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
